requirements.evidence: Exact-candidate tcm run 36518581106 and test job failed: 6 failed, 1828 passed, 6 skipped; five hub-presence failures are new.
Exact-base tcm run 36518584681 and test job failed only the moving-origin/master state-schema.test.ts:248 assertion: 1 failed, 1824 passed, 6 skipped.

acceptance.evidence: Fixture test passed pollingNow=true to 'grok: polling', but the unqualified Partner presence/seat wording can be read as proof the seat saw the turn when only a listener process polled.
Fixture test passed count and age ('3 unread since 5m'), but polling/not polling is still presented as seat state instead of listener state.

Unreachable, HTTP 503 and invalid-JSON tests passed; hanging fixture returned one timeout line in 3011 ms. A 200 body with rooms:{} threw agent.rooms?.find is not a function instead of returning UNKNOWN.
Focused candidate test returned cursor-builder: absent for a missing partner.
Reapplied exact-candidate mutant b461300 typechecked and made all three selected PR-3 tests fail with missing lines.

Existing handleStart tests passed 13/13 and are unchanged; presence 9/9 and greeting-size 8/8 passed. sync's composeGreeting measured 48244 without presence; representative block adds 180 to 48424, but greeting-size does not include it.

gaps: Listener polling is labelled as partner/seat presence, so a planner can infer the seat saw a turn.
Nested presence fields are not validated; structurally malformed rooms can throw instead of printing UNKNOWN.
The greeting-size composition omits the new presence block.
QA semantic mutant 26a4679 falsely claims the seat saw the turn and survives all nine focused tests.
Five candidate fixture-server tests fail in mandatory tcm CI under egress isolation.
